This repository defines **four memo webhook activity types**. All dispatch flows converge on `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, which enqueues work consumed by background workers that call `webhook.Post` for the actual HTTP delivery.

---

## Event → Dispatch Function Mapping

| Activity type (`payload.ActivityType`) | Public dispatch function | Internal helper | Defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `memos.memo.created` | `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` | `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15–16` |
| `memos.memo.updated` | `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` | `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20–21` |
| `memos.memo.deleted` | `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` | `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25–26` |
| `memos.memo.comment.created` | `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` | *(none — inline logic)* | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30–45` |

There are **no other memo webhook activity types** in the codebase (confirmed by searching for `memos.memo.` and all `DispatchMemo*Webhook` references).
